name: ivre/ivre
description: Network recon framework for building self-hosted alternatives to Shodan, ZoomEye, Censys and GreyNoise. Runs passive DNS, EASM, and network intelligence collection using Nmap, Masscan, and Zeek.
score_rationale: 4k stars for a unique self-hosted internet-scanning framework that fills a critical niche as an open-source Shodan alternative with active development through 2024.
